issue.title: Build historical bead ID re-prefix migration
issue.description: Approved plan plans:202608/bead_prefix_mint_guard.md identified pre-fix stores such as bob-cli whose issue_prefix leaked the ProjectSpec key gh_bobs-org__bob-cli. The mint guard only forward-repairs future top-level beads; existing key-prefixed IDs remain in event streams, bead_id frontmatter in sidecar plans, design refs, ChangeSpecs, agent names, chat transcripts, and commit history. Scope: design and implement a safe historical bead ID re-prefix migration, including a rename primitive in sase-core, cross-repo reference rewrites, dry-run/audit output, rollback or recovery semantics, and tests proving mixed-prefix stores migrate without losing lineage.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during unrelated coder-alias verification on 2026-08-03: full just check failed the core-binding exposure test because bead_prefix_migration_apply, bead_prefix_migration_preview, bead_rewrite_id_tokens, and bead_validate_issue_prefix are collected from source but absent from sase_core_rs. The same focused rerun kept bead shorthand canonicalization tests failing because shorthand IDs such as 1/1.1 were not resolved. This corroborates the active historical re-prefix primitive work.

payload.entry: Verified at close: bob-cli bead store config.json is {issue_prefix: bob-cli, next_counter: 15} with five renamed event streams and thirteen closed issues under the new IDs; the leaked-prefix token audit is clean across the bob-cli beads sidecar, plans sidecar, agents sidecar, and ~/.sase/agent_name_registry.json.

payload.close_reason: Superseded by epic sase-ez. sase-eh asked for a general historical bead ID re-prefix migration feature (sase-core rename primitive, cross-repo reference rewrites, dry-run/audit output, rollback semantics). The owner abandoned that feature while it was being built: epic sase-ei was closed canceled by sase-ez.3, and every commit it produced was reverted in both repositories. The underlying problem sase-eh identified is nonetheless resolved. bob-cli was the only project with real leaked-prefix beads and was corrected by the one-off hand migration in sase-ez.4 (thirteen beads now bob-cli-a through bob-cli-e, next_counter 15, no gh_bobs-org__bob-cli-<counter> tokens outside immutable git history). actstat's config also carried a leaked issue_prefix but has zero beads and no event streams, so the forward mint guard from 202608/bead_prefix_mint_guard.md repairs it on first use. The sase store was already correct. Closed by sase-ez.land during the epic land audit; reopen with 'sase bead open sase-eh' if another project ever accumulates leaked-prefix beads and a general migration becomes worth its cost.
